scope: Local macOS arm64; real public QUIC SDK, protected grant exchange, owned worker/server restart and pinned Vapi SDK against a fake loopback remote service. No account activity or remote deployment.

requirements.requirement: Task, step and logical mutation persist before dispatch with linked ordinary receipt and provider observation
Failure before commit or after commit/before ACK retains one effect; failed writes roll back and preserve original intent
Competing handles produce one mutation; bounded revision-controlled claims renew/reclaim only safe work
Remote acceptance without known receipt remains uncertain after worker/server restart, with no second dispatch
Current cancel/revocation cannot authorize matching accepted replay or later physical dispatch

retained_attempts.result: Initial journey reached post-restart effect inspection after successful uncertainty/replay assertions; server correctly denied EffectGet to a Send-only grant. Corrected fixture retains the denial assertion and inspects using a separately authorized owner client. No production authority was widened.

not_claimed: Application business-effect transactions or complete Gate 4 journeys
closure: Core effect intent, claims and uncertainty requirements qualified. Installed provider/host journeys, app business transactions and A4/T-A integrated qualification remain separate.

review.production_changes: None in this audit; Store owns receipts/effect/claim transactions, Connector owns HTTP delivery, Worker owns dispatch/recovery, public clients observe status and replay. Existing strict Store/Service/Server Clippy/Rustdoc qualification remains applicable to unchanged production modules.
review.conservative_outcome: A local accepted Send receipt does not prove provider completion. Independent fake remote effect count remains one, while persisted job and task effect remain uncertain after restarting both worker and server. Send-only grant does not gain RequestStatus authority.
